l4_steps.name: Pull TSA Security Directive updates from portal
l4_steps.input: Daily TSA operational bulletin and Security Directive notifications
l4_steps.output: Updated security parameters and procedural changes for departure day
l4_steps.kpi: Directive review completion 100% by 04:00 local; zero missed directives
l4_steps.pain_point: TSA directives arrive with minimal lead time and no automated push — coordinator must manually poll the portal daily; late directives received after briefings require real-time re-briefing of ramp and gate teams

l4_steps.name: Configure Secure Flight data elements in PSS
l4_steps.input: Updated TSA directive, PNR database for day-of-departure flights
l4_steps.output: Secure Flight data fields (name, DOB, gender, redress number) enabled and validated for all active PNRs
l4_steps.kpi: Secure Flight data completeness ≥99.5% of PNRs before check-in window opens
l4_steps.pain_point: Missing Secure Flight data from OTA and indirect bookings (name misspellings, missing DOB) requires last-minute PNR remediation calls to passengers — average 4–6 incidents per hub departure bank

l4_steps.name: Verify Airport Security Program compliance readiness
l4_steps.input: TSA-approved Airport Security Program (ASP) document, staffing roster, certification records
l4_steps.output: Compliance readiness checklist signed off; uncertified staff removed from security-sensitive positions
l4_steps.kpi: ASP readiness sign-off ≥60 min before first departure; 100% rostered security staff TSA-certified
l4_steps.pain_point: High turnover at outstations leads to uncertified agents being inadvertently rostered in AOA access roles — TSA civil penalties up to $25,000 per violation; AMS roster does not flag certification expiry automatically

l4_steps.name: Transmit Secure Flight Passenger Data Records to TSA
l4_steps.input: PNR passenger name, date of birth, gender, redress number (if held)
l4_steps.output: Secure Flight data batch transmitted to TSA; transmission acknowledgement logged
l4_steps.kpi: Transmission ≥72 hours before departure for advance bookings; 100% transmitted before check-in opens for same-day bookings
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa Secure Flight module timeout during high-volume morning bank causes batch retransmission queues; TSA SLA requires 2-min response window — backlog during irregular operations extends to 15+ min, blocking boarding pass issuance

l4_steps.name: Receive Boarding Pass Print Result from TSA
l4_steps.input: TSA BPPR response codes: OK, SSSS (enhanced screening), or Inhibited (no-fly)
l4_steps.output: Boarding authorization flag applied to each PNR in Altéa; inhibited passengers flagged for escalation
l4_steps.kpi: BPPR response received within 2 min per passenger; 100% BPPR statuses resolved before check-in closes
l4_steps.pain_point: TSA BPPR 'Inhibited' status returned without explanation — agent must call TSA help desk with average hold time of 8–12 min; no case tracking integration between Altéa and TSA portal causes duplicate escalation calls

l4_steps.name: Escalate SSSS or No-Fly result to TSA liaison
l4_steps.input: SSSS or Inhibited BPPR flag from Altéa, passenger PNR details
l4_steps.output: TSA case reference number issued; SSSS passenger directed to enhanced screening lane; no-fly passenger offloaded and PNR annotated
l4_steps.kpi: SSSS coordination completed ≥45 min before departure; no-fly offload confirmed ≥30 min before departure; 100% SSSS passengers cleared or offloaded before gate close
l4_steps.pain_point: Redress number mismatches cause false positives for passengers with common names — average 3–4 false positives per week at major hubs; each requires DHS TRIP form initiation and manual TSA override, averaging 20 min per incident

l4_steps.name: Verify passenger identity document at gate
l4_steps.input: Government-issued photo ID, boarding pass scan, REAL ID enforcement flag
l4_steps.output: Identity verified and documented; boarding pass scanned; PNR boarding status updated in AMS
l4_steps.kpi: Gate document check throughput <45 sec per passenger; REAL ID non-compliance interception rate 100%; boarding completion ≥10 min before departure
l4_steps.pain_point: No automated integration between AMS ID scanner and Altéa PNR — agent must manually annotate non-compliance; inconsistent REAL ID passenger awareness creates gate-queue backlog averaging 4 min per non-compliant incident

l4_steps.name: Handle REAL ID non-compliance exception at gate
l4_steps.input: Non-compliant ID flagged at gate scan; TSA alternate acceptable ID list
l4_steps.output: Passenger offered TSA-approved alternate documents; denied boarding if no acceptable ID presented; denial documented in Altéa PNR remarks
l4_steps.kpi: REAL ID exception resolution <5 min; denied boarding documented in Altéa within 15 min of incident; zero passengers boarded without TSA-acceptable ID
l4_steps.pain_point: No automated link between AMS gate scanner and Altéa PNR creates audit gaps flagged in TSA compliance inspections; manual annotation relies on agent recall during high-throughput boarding — data quality degrades under pressure

l4_steps.name: Submit hold baggage manifest to TSA EDS screening
l4_steps.input: Checked baggage tags, weight manifest, passenger count for flight
l4_steps.output: Baggage screening manifest submitted; TSA EDS queue populated with all bag tags
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of hold bags submitted to EDS before ramp loading begins; EDS screening throughput ≥300 bags/hr at Level 1
l4_steps.pain_point: EDS machine downtime averages 4.2 hr/month per unit at busy stations; fallback to manual ETD screening reduces throughput by 60% and directly risks D0 departure delay — no automated EDS status feed into BagManager to trigger backup protocol

l4_steps.name: Execute passenger-baggage reconciliation check
l4_steps.input: Checked-in passenger list from Altéa DCS vs. boarded passenger scan list from gate
l4_steps.output: Reconciliation report: matched, unmatched, and flagged bags; departure hold issued if mismatch found
l4_steps.kpi: Reconciliation completed ≥15 min before scheduled departure; mismatched bag rate <0.1% of loaded bags
l4_steps.pain_point: Interline baggage transfers lack real-time status in BagManager — connecting bags from partner carriers are invisible to reconciliation logic; increases unaccompanied bag risk on multi-carrier itineraries handled at shared terminals

l4_steps.name: Remove and re-screen unaccompanied baggage
l4_steps.input: Unmatched bag tag identified in reconciliation report; TSA officer tasking request
l4_steps.output: Bag located, off-loaded, quarantined, and re-screened; departure hold issued; BagManager updated with off-load record
l4_steps.kpi: Unaccompanied bag off-load completed <10 min of identification; zero unaccompanied bags loaded; off-load documented 100% in BagManager
l4_steps.pain_point: Off-loading a reconciliation-mismatched bag from a loaded aircraft requires full ramp access re-coordination with TSA and averages 18-min departure delay — each incident costs approximately $8,400 in direct delay costs and downstream slot penalties at coordinated airports

l4_steps.name: Transmit eAPIS passenger manifest to CBP
l4_steps.input: PNR passport and visa data, crew manifest, flight departure details
l4_steps.output: eAPIS manifest transmitted to CBP; acknowledgement receipt logged with timestamp
l4_steps.kpi: Manifest transmitted ≥60 min before international departure per 19 CFR 122.49a; 100% transmission rate; CBP acknowledgement within 10 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Passport data OCR errors from self-service kiosks and online check-in produce CBP manifest rejections — average 2.3 passport corrections per international flight; each manual correction and CBP resubmission adds 8–10 min to pre-departure workload

l4_steps.name: Receive and action CBP pre-departure APIS response
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa PSS + CBP eAPIS Portal
l4_steps.input: CBP per-passenger clearance or no-board response codes
l4_steps.output: No-board orders applied to PNR and flagged in Altéa; cleared passengers proceed to boarding
l4_steps.kpi: CBP no-board response processed ≤10 min of receipt; 100% no-board orders actioned before gate close
l4_steps.pain_point: CBP no-board orders occasionally arrive after gate close due to APIS processing latency — requires aircraft door reopening and coordinated offload, averaging 25-min delay and possible slot forfeiture at slot-controlled international airports (JFK, LGA, DCA, ORD)

l4_steps.name: Offload CBP no-board passenger and associated bags
l4_steps.input: CBP no-board order with passenger PNR and all associated baggage tag numbers
l4_steps.output: Passenger denied boarding; all associated bags located, off-loaded, and quarantined; CBP case number logged in Altéa PNR
l4_steps.kpi: No-board offload completed <15 min of order receipt; 100% associated baggage removed before departure; CBP case number documented in PNR
l4_steps.pain_point: Multi-segment bookings with interline bag transfers make associated baggage identification time-consuming — BagManager search limited to locally scanned bags; bags transferred from partner carriers on feeder flights are invisible, risking incomplete removal and TSA violation

l4_steps.name: Report security incident to TSA Operations Center
l4_steps.input: Incident type classification, timestamp, affected passenger PNR, witness statements, gate CCTV reference
l4_steps.output: TSA incident report filed; case reference number issued; station log updated
l4_steps.kpi: Initial report filed within 4 hours of occurrence per 49 CFR Part 1544.305; 100% incident capture with zero unreported events
l4_steps.pain_point: TSA eFile portal has no mobile interface — field agents must return to operations counter to file reports; creates reporting delays during concurrent gate incidents and documentation gaps when multiple events occur simultaneously across a departure bank

l4_steps.name: Conduct post-departure security compliance audit
l4_steps.system: SITA Airport Management System (AMS) + Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.input: Boarding records, Secure Flight BPPR logs, BagManager reconciliation reports, ID check gate logs
l4_steps.output: Daily security compliance audit report; exception list with root-cause annotations for corrective action; submitted to airline security compliance team
l4_steps.kpi: Audit report completed within 2 hours of last departure; security exception rate <1% of daily passengers processed; 100% exceptions assigned corrective owner
l4_steps.pain_point: No unified compliance dashboard — AMS gate logs, Altéa BPPR records, and BagManager reconciliation data must be manually cross-referenced; average 45 min/day of manual report assembly per station; data format inconsistencies between systems cause reconciliation errors flagged in TSA programmatic inspections
